blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解品質系統如何為污染控制策略 (CCS) 的各層面提供框架與驅動力
blocks.en: Understand how the quality system provides the framework and driving force for every aspect of the contamination control strategy (CCS)

blocks.zh: 掌握趨勢分析與指標 (Trending and Metrics) 在 CCS 整體性能監控中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the role of trending and metrics in monitoring overall CCS performance

blocks.zh: 了解調查 (Investigation)、CAPA、變更管制 (Change Control) 如何形成 CCS 的反饋迴路
blocks.en: Understand how investigation, CAPA and change control form the feedback loop of the CCS

blocks.zh: 認識品質風險管理 (QRM) 在建立與維護 CCS 中的基礎地位
blocks.en: Recognize the foundational role of quality risk management (QRM) in establishing and maintaining the CCS

blocks.zh: 理解品質協議 (Quality Agreements) 與供應商管理對污染控制的關鍵作用
blocks.en: Understand the key role of quality agreements and vendor management in contamination control

blocks.zh: 掌握品質管制實驗室 (Quality Controls) 在 CCS 中的 GMP 治理要求
blocks.en: Understand the GMP governance requirements for quality control laboratories (Quality Controls) within the CCS

blocks.zh: 11.0 Quality Systems 品質系統
blocks.en: 11.0 Quality Systems

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Quality Systems (品質系統)：品質系統是整個 CCS 運作的「骨架」。它不是某個單一文件或程序，而是一整套互相連結的管理機制，包含趨勢分析、調查、CAPA、變更管制、品質風險管理 (QRM)、品質協議與治理等要素。
blocks.en: Quality Systems: The quality system is the "backbone" on which the whole CCS operates. It is not a single document or procedure, but a set of interlinked management mechanisms that includes trending, investigation, CAPA, change control, quality risk management (QRM), quality agreements and governance.

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 (藥品品質系統)：ICH Q10 是國際協和會議發布的藥品品質系統指引，它為製藥企業提供了一個整合性的品質管理模型，涵蓋產品全生命週期。TR90 特別指出 ICH Q10 提供了進一步的細節與實施策略。
blocks.en: ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System): ICH Q10 is the pharmaceutical quality system guideline issued by the International Council for Harmonisation. It gives pharmaceutical companies an integrated quality management model that covers the whole product lifecycle. TR90 specifically notes that ICH Q10 provides further detail and implementation strategies.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 品質系統就像醫院的感染管控計畫 (Hospital Infection Control Plan)。醫院不是只靠一條規定就能防止院內感染，而是需要一整套系統：監測數據（趨勢分析）、異常調查、改善措施 (CAPA)、流程變更管理、風險評估、與外部供應商的品質協議等。所有這些環環相扣，缺一不可。CCS 中的品質系統扮演的正是這個角色。
blocks.en: A quality system is like a hospital infection control plan. A hospital cannot prevent hospital-acquired infections with a single rule; it needs a complete system: monitoring data (trending), investigation of abnormal events, improvement actions (CAPA), management of process changes, risk assessment, quality agreements with outside suppliers, and so on. All of these are interlocked, and none can be left out. The quality system in the CCS plays exactly this role.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 本節是理解 CCS 如何「活起來」的關鍵。前面各章節討論的是污染控制的技術要素（設施、人員、製程、環境監測等），而本章的品質系統則是讓這些要素持續改善、彼此協調的管理引擎。沒有健全的品質系統，再好的技術控制也會隨時間退化。
blocks.en: This section is the key to understanding how the CCS "comes alive". The earlier sections discuss the technical elements of contamination control (facilities, personnel, process, environmental monitoring and so on), while the quality system in this section is the management engine that keeps those elements improving and coordinated. Without a sound quality system, even the best technical controls will degrade over time.

blocks.zh: 11.1 Trending and Metrics 趨勢分析與指標
blocks.en: 11.1 Trending and Metrics

blocks.zh: Predictive Metrics (預測性指標)：這些是「前瞻性」指標，用來評估系統的健康狀態，在問題發生之前就發出信號。例如：品質文化相關 KPI、資本再投資計畫、風險緩解進度、CAPA 按時完成率、確效與驗證排程的遵守度等。
blocks.en: Predictive Metrics: These are "forward-looking" indicators used to assess the health of the system and to give a signal before problems occur. Examples include quality culture KPIs, capital reinvestment plans, progress of risk mitigation, on-time CAPA completion rate, and adherence to the validation and qualification schedule.

blocks.zh: Reactive Metrics (反應性指標)：這些是「事後性」指標，反映已經發生的問題。例如：設施偏差、製程不符合、產品不符合（如無菌試驗失敗）、環境監測趨勢偏離、非計畫性維護等。
blocks.en: Reactive Metrics: These are "after-the-fact" indicators that reflect problems that have already occurred. Examples include facility deviations, process nonconformances, product nonconformances (such as a sterility test failure), environmental monitoring trend excursions, and unplanned maintenance.

blocks.zh: Holistic Analysis (整體性分析)：趨勢分析的目標不是逐一檢視單一事件，而是從時間軸和不同情境中辨識模式 (patterns)、潛在影響因子和真正的根本原因。
blocks.en: Holistic Analysis: The aim of trending is not to review single events one by one, but to identify patterns, potential contributing factors and true root causes across time and across different situations.

blocks.zh: 想像你在管理一支棒球隊。預測性指標就像「訓練出席率」、「體能測試成績」、「守備練習時數」——它們告訴你未來比賽的準備是否到位。反應性指標則像「失誤次數」、「被安打數」、「失分」——它們是已經發生的結果。好的教練（品質管理者）會同時看兩類指標，而不是等到輸球才反應。
blocks.en: Imagine you manage a baseball team. Predictive metrics are like "training attendance", "fitness test scores" and "hours of fielding practice": they tell you whether preparation for future games is on track. Reactive metrics are like "errors", "hits allowed" and "runs conceded": they are results that have already happened. A good coach (quality manager) looks at both kinds of metrics rather than waiting to react until the team has lost.

blocks.zh: Table 11.1-1🔍 是稽核準備時的重要參考。法規稽核人員經常會問：「你們的 CCS 績效指標是什麼？如何追蹤？」如果你只有反應性指標（偏差數、失敗數），稽核人員會質疑你的系統缺乏前瞻性。一個成熟的 CCS 必須兩者兼具。
blocks.en: Table 11.1-1🔍 is an important reference for audit preparation. Regulatory inspectors often ask: "What are your CCS performance indicators, and how do you track them?" If you have only reactive metrics (number of deviations, number of failures), the inspector will question whether your system lacks a forward-looking view. A mature CCS must have both.

blocks.zh: 特別注意「品質文化相關 KPI」這個預測性指標。EU GMP Annex 1 強烈強調品質文化的重要性，TR90 將其納入可量化的指標體系中。
blocks.en: Pay particular attention to the predictive metric "quality culture KPIs". EU GMP Annex 1 strongly emphasizes the importance of quality culture, and TR90 brings it into a quantifiable metrics framework.

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Table Analysis
blocks.en: Table Analysis

blocks.zh: Table 11.1-1🔍 的設計將預測性與反應性指標並列呈現，暗示兩者應在定期審查 (Periodic Review) 中同時評估。左欄（預測性）側重系統投入與預防措施，右欄（反應性）側重實際結果與偏差。兩者的交叉分析才能提供完整的 CCS 健康圖像。
blocks.en: Table 11.1-1🔍 presents predictive and reactive metrics side by side, which implies that both should be evaluated together in periodic review. The left column (predictive) focuses on system inputs and preventive measures, and the right column (reactive) focuses on actual outcomes and deviations. Only a cross-analysis of the two gives a complete picture of CCS health.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，建議建立一個 CCS 儀表板 (Dashboard)，將預測性與反應性指標以視覺化方式呈現。例如每月追蹤：CAPA 關閉率、環境監測偏差趨勢、確效排程遵守率、非計畫維護次數。這些數據可直接用於管理審查 (Management Review) 和客戶稽核回應。
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, we recommend building a CCS dashboard that presents predictive and reactive metrics visually. For example, track monthly: CAPA closure rate, environmental monitoring excursion trends, validation schedule adherence rate, and number of unplanned maintenance events. These data can be used directly for management review and for responses to customer audits.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 要求 CCS 指標同時包含預測性與反應性指標？如果只有反應性指標會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 require CCS metrics to include both predictive and reactive metrics? What are the risks if there are only reactive metrics?

blocks.zh: 「品質文化相關 KPI」可以用哪些具體的可量化指標來衡量？
blocks.en: What specific, quantifiable indicators can be used to measure "quality culture KPIs"?

blocks.zh: Control charting 中的 variable data 和 attribute data 在環境監測中分別對應什麼類型的數據？
blocks.en: In environmental monitoring, what types of data correspond to variable data and attribute data in control charting?

blocks.zh: 11.2 Investigation 調查
blocks.en: 11.2 Investigation

blocks.zh: Feedback Loop (反饋迴路)：調查是 CCS 反饋迴路的一部分。當監測數據、偏差或客訴觸發調查時，調查結果會回饋到 CCS，驅動控制要素的改善與精煉。這就是 Figure 3.0-1🔍 中所描繪的持續改善循環。
blocks.en: Feedback Loop: Investigation is part of the CCS feedback loop. When monitoring data, deviations or complaints trigger an investigation, the findings feed back into the CCS and drive improvement and refinement of the control elements. This is the continual improvement cycle depicted in Figure 3.0-1🔍.

blocks.zh: Holistic Fashion (整體性方式)：調查不應該只聚焦在表面症狀。即使看似是一次性事件 (one-off event)，也必須從整體 CCS 的角度進行分析，避免預設調查結論 (predetermined investigational outcome)。
blocks.en: Holistic Fashion: An investigation should not focus only on surface symptoms. Even an apparent one-off event must be analyzed from the perspective of the overall CCS, avoiding a predetermined investigational outcome.

blocks.zh: Microbial Risk Assessment (微生物風險評估)：這是一項前瞻性措施，用於理解 CCS 的潛在弱點並支持製程理解。它不僅在偏差調查中使用，更應該在日常維護中定期執行。
blocks.en: Microbial Risk Assessment: This is a proactive measure used to understand potential weaknesses of the CCS and to support process understanding. It is used not only in deviation investigations but should also be performed regularly as part of routine maintenance.

blocks.zh: 調查就像醫生的診斷過程。當病人出現症狀（偏差），好的醫生不會直接下結論，而是會全面檢查（holistic fashion），排除各種可能性，找到真正的病因（root cause）。如果每次頭痛就只開止痛藥（表面處理），而不去查是否有高血壓或腦部問題（系統性原因），病人的健康只會越來越差。CCS 調查也是同樣的道理。
blocks.en: An investigation is like a doctor's diagnostic process. When a patient presents with symptoms (a deviation), a good doctor does not jump to a conclusion but examines the patient comprehensively (holistic fashion), rules out the various possibilities and finds the real cause (root cause). If a doctor simply prescribes a painkiller for every headache (treating the surface) without checking for high blood pressure or a brain problem (systemic causes), the patient's health will only get worse. CCS investigations work the same way.

blocks.zh: 「不預設調查結論」(without a predetermined investigational outcome) 是稽核中最容易被指出的缺陷之一。常見的錯誤模式是：環境監測偏差發生後，調查報告總是得出「可能是人員操作問題」的結論，卻未真正探索設施、設備、物料或系統設計等其他可能的根本原因。
blocks.en: "Without a predetermined investigational outcome" is one of the deficiencies most often cited in audits. A common failure pattern is that, after an environmental monitoring excursion, the investigation report always concludes "probably an operator handling issue" without genuinely exploring other possible root causes such as facility, equipment, materials or system design.

blocks.zh: TR90 特別引用 PDA TR88 作為微生物偏差調查的詳細指引，這顯示了 PDA 技術報告之間的互補關係。在實務中，建議同時參考 TR88 來建立標準化的調查流程。
blocks.en: TR90 specifically cites PDA TR88 as detailed guidance on microbial deviation investigations, which shows how the PDA technical reports complement one another. In practice, we recommend referring to TR88 as well when building a standardized investigation process.

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 而言，建議制定標準化的環境監測偏差調查模板 (EM Investigation Template)，涵蓋：事件描述、影響範圍評估、可能根本原因清單（設施、人員、設備、物料、方法）、微生物鑑定結果、CCS 弱點分析、CAPA 建議。這樣可以加速調查流程，同時確保調查的完整性與一致性。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, we recommend developing a standardized EM investigation template that covers: event description, impact scope assessment, a list of possible root causes (facility, personnel, equipment, materials, methods), microbial identification results, CCS weakness analysis, and CAPA recommendations. This speeds up the investigation process while ensuring completeness and consistency.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 強調調查應以「整體性方式」進行，而非僅針對單一偏差事件？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 emphasize that investigations should be conducted in a "holistic fashion" rather than only for a single deviation event?

blocks.zh: 什麼是「預設調查結論」？請舉一個實際的例子說明為何這是不當做法。
blocks.en: What is a "predetermined investigational outcome"? Give a practical example of why this is inappropriate practice.

blocks.zh: 微生物風險評估在偏差調查中應扮演什麼角色？它與偏差調查的先後順序關係為何？
blocks.en: What role should microbial risk assessment play in a deviation investigation? How does it relate in sequence to the deviation investigation?

blocks.zh: 11.3 Corrective And Preventive Actions 矯正與預防措施
blocks.en: 11.3 Corrective And Preventive Actions

blocks.zh: CAPA (矯正與預防措施)：CAPA 是品質系統中最核心的改善工具之一。矯正措施 (Corrective Action) 針對已發生的問題進行修正；預防措施 (Preventive Action) 則是防止類似問題再次發生。在 CCS 框架中，CAPA 是將調查結果轉化為實際改善的橋樑。
blocks.en: CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Actions): CAPA is one of the most central improvement tools in the quality system. A corrective action addresses a problem that has already occurred, while a preventive action prevents similar problems from recurring. Within the CCS framework, CAPA is the bridge that turns investigation findings into actual improvement.

blocks.zh: CAPA Effectiveness Checks (CAPA 有效性確認)：不是做了 CAPA 就完事。每項 CAPA 都應該有後續的有效性確認機制，以驗證措施確實解決了問題。這應被追蹤為品質指標之一。
blocks.en: CAPA Effectiveness Checks: Implementing a CAPA is not the end of the matter. Every CAPA should have a follow-up effectiveness check mechanism to verify that the action actually solved the problem. This should be tracked as one of the quality metrics.

blocks.zh: Reduction in Testing (減少測試)：這是一個非常重要的概念。當 CAPA 真正強化了 CCS 並防止了污染，企業可以合理地減少某些測試和監督，例如關閉某個製程步驟。這體現了「風險為基礎」的管理哲學。
blocks.en: Reduction in Testing: This is a very important concept. When a CAPA genuinely strengthens the CCS and prevents contamination, a company can reasonably reduce certain testing and oversight, for example by closing out a process step. This reflects a risk-based management philosophy.

blocks.zh: CAPA 就像房屋維修後的驗收。如果你家漏水（偏差），找出漏水原因（調查）後進行修繕（CAPA），但修完之後不去確認是否真的不漏了（effectiveness check），那下一場大雨可能又會漏水。而如果你不只修了漏水點，還順便加強了整個屋頂的防水（強化整體 CCS），那你甚至可以減少未來的巡檢頻率（reduction in testing）。
blocks.en: CAPA is like the acceptance inspection after a house repair. If your house leaks (a deviation), you find the cause of the leak (investigation) and make the repair (CAPA), but you never check whether it really stopped leaking (effectiveness check), then the next heavy rain may cause a leak again. And if you not only fixed the leak point but also strengthened the waterproofing of the whole roof (strengthening the overall CCS), you may even be able to reduce the frequency of future inspections (reduction in testing).

blocks.zh: TR90 強調 CAPA 應考慮「整個 CCS」，包括直接受影響的要素和間接受影響的要素。這意味著一個好的 CAPA 不僅解決眼前的問題，更應該從系統層面思考其連鎖效應。例如，如果 CAPA 改變了某個清潔程序，應同時評估對環境監測、人員培訓、確效狀態等其他 CCS 要素的影響。
blocks.en: TR90 emphasizes that CAPA should consider the "whole CCS", including both directly and indirectly affected elements. This means a good CAPA not only solves the immediate problem but also considers its knock-on effects at the system level. For example, if a CAPA changes a cleaning procedure, the impact on other CCS elements such as environmental monitoring, personnel training and validation status should be assessed at the same time.

blocks.zh: 「將 CAPA 的新知識回饋到 CCS」這一步經常被忽略。TR90 建議在 Section 12.0 描述的定期生命週期審查中完成這項工作，確保 CCS 是一份持續演進的活文件。
blocks.en: The step of "feeding new knowledge from CAPA back into the CCS" is often overlooked. TR90 recommends completing this work in the periodic lifecycle review described in Section 12.0, so that the CCS remains a continually evolving living document.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 說「最有效的 CAPA 可能會增強跨設施、多製程和多產品的多項控制」？請用實際例子說明。
blocks.en: Why does TR90 say "the most effective CAPAs may enhance multiple controls across facilities, multiple processes and multiple products"? Explain with a practical example.

blocks.zh: CAPA 如何可能導致「減少測試和監督」？這需要什麼前提條件才能合理實施？
blocks.en: How can a CAPA lead to a "reduction in testing and oversight"? What preconditions are needed for this to be implemented reasonably?

blocks.zh: 如果一項 CAPA 的有效性確認失敗了，下一步應該怎麼做？
blocks.en: If the effectiveness check of a CAPA fails, what should the next step be?

blocks.zh: 11.4 Change Control 變更管制
blocks.en: 11.4 Change Control

blocks.zh: Change Control (變更管制)：任何對產品、製程或設施的變更都可能改變 CCS 的風險態勢。變更管制程序確保在實施變更前，充分評估其對污染控制的潛在影響。
blocks.en: Change Control: Any change to a product, process or facility can alter the risk profile of the CCS. The change control procedure ensures that the potential impact on contamination control is fully assessed before the change is implemented.

blocks.zh: Ad-hoc Risk Review (臨時風險審查)：不同於定期的風險評估，ad-hoc risk review 是因應特定變更而觸發的額外風險審查。它確保每個可能影響 CCS 的變更都經過適當的風險評估。
blocks.en: Ad-hoc Risk Review: Unlike periodic risk assessments, an ad-hoc risk review is an additional risk review triggered by a specific change. It ensures that every change that may affect the CCS undergoes an appropriate risk assessment.

blocks.zh: SMEs (主題專家)：變更的污染影響評估不應由單一部門完成，而是需要多方專家參與：被變更系統的專家、污染控制專家和品質專家。
blocks.en: SMEs (Subject Matter Experts): The contamination impact assessment of a change should not be done by a single department. It requires the participation of multiple experts: experts on the system being changed, contamination control experts and quality experts.

blocks.zh: 變更管制就像居家裝修時的結構評估。你想在牆上開一個窗戶（製程變更），即使只是一面牆的變動，也必須請結構工程師評估是否會影響整棟房子的承重結構（CCS）。不能因為「只是小改動」就跳過評估——因為有時候一個看似小的改變，可能導致整個系統的完整性受損。
blocks.en: Change control is like a structural assessment during a home renovation. If you want to cut a window into a wall (a process change), even though it affects only one wall, you must have a structural engineer assess whether it will affect the load-bearing structure of the whole house (the CCS). You cannot skip the assessment because it is "just a small change", since sometimes an apparently small change can compromise the integrity of the entire system.

blocks.zh: TR90 用了 "inherent risk"（固有風險）這個詞來描述變更帶來的污染風險，這強調了一個重要原則：變更本身就是風險。不是說變更一定會造成問題，而是每次變更都「天生」帶有打破現有控制平衡的風險。因此，即使變更的初衷是改善，也必須評估其可能帶來的負面影響。
blocks.en: TR90 uses the term "inherent risk" to describe the contamination risk introduced by a change, which highlights an important principle: change itself is a risk. This does not mean a change will necessarily cause a problem, but that every change inherently carries the risk of upsetting the balance of existing controls. Therefore, even if the intent of a change is improvement, its potential negative effects must be assessed.

blocks.zh: 在稽核中，法規機構會特別關注：是否所有影響 CCS 的變更都經過適當的風險評估？變更管制記錄中是否有污染控制影響的專門評估欄位？
blocks.en: In an audit, regulators will pay particular attention to the following. Have all changes affecting the CCS undergone an appropriate risk assessment? Do the change control records have a dedicated field for assessing the impact on contamination control?

blocks.zh: 請列舉三個看似與污染控制無關、但實際上可能影響 CCS 的變更類型。
blocks.en: List three types of change that appear unrelated to contamination control but could actually affect the CCS.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 要求變更的污染影響評估必須由多方 SME 共同完成？單一部門評估的風險是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 require the contamination impact assessment of a change to be done jointly by multiple SMEs? What is the risk of an assessment by a single department?

blocks.zh: 11.5 Quality Risk Management 品質風險管理
blocks.en: 11.5 Quality Risk Management

blocks.zh: Quality Risk Management, QRM (品質風險管理)：QRM 是 CCS 的基礎要素之一。它不是一份單一文件，而是多份聚焦於不同污染控制面向的風險評估的總和。ICH Q9 提供了 QRM 的方法論框架。
blocks.en: Quality Risk Management, QRM: QRM is one of the foundational elements of the CCS. It is not a single document but the sum of multiple risk assessments focused on different aspects of contamination control. ICH Q9 provides the methodological framework for QRM.

blocks.zh: Living Documents (活文件)：風險評估不是「做完就歸檔」的一次性工作。它們是需要定期重新評估的活文件，隨著新知識、新數據和新變更而持續更新。
blocks.en: Living Documents: A risk assessment is not a one-time exercise that is "completed and filed away". Risk assessments are living documents that need to be reassessed periodically and kept up to date as new knowledge, new data and new changes emerge.

blocks.zh: Design FMEA (設計失效模式與效應分析)：用於在製程設計階段識別潛在的失效模式及其對產品品質的影響，是預防污染的最佳工具之一。
blocks.en: Design FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis): Used at the process design stage to identify potential failure modes and their effects on product quality; it is one of the best tools for preventing contamination.

blocks.zh: HACCP (危害分析與關鍵控制點)：源自食品安全領域，在製藥中用於確定周邊控制策略是否足夠，以及識別製程中的取樣位置以監控設計和控制的有效性。
blocks.en: HACCP (Hazard Analysis and Critical Control Points): Originating in the food safety field, it is used in pharmaceutical manufacturing to determine whether the perimeter control strategy is sufficient and to identify sampling locations in the process for monitoring the effectiveness of the design and controls.

blocks.zh: QRM 就像一座城市的防災計畫。一座城市不可能只用一種方法來防所有災害——地震需要建築規範（類似 FMEA），洪水需要排水系統和監測站（類似 HACCP），火災需要消防法規和撒水系統（類似 Preliminary Hazard Analysis）。CCS 中的 QRM 也是如此：針對不同的污染風險面向，使用不同的風險評估工具，匯總成一個完整的風險管理體系。
blocks.en: QRM is like a city's disaster prevention plan. A city cannot use a single method to protect against every disaster: earthquakes require building codes (similar to FMEA), floods require drainage systems and monitoring stations (similar to HACCP), and fires require fire regulations and sprinkler systems (similar to Preliminary Hazard Analysis). QRM in the CCS works the same way: different risk assessment tools are used for different aspects of contamination risk, and together they form a complete risk management system.

blocks.zh: TR90 明確指出：「沒有單一的風險評估工具適用於所有風險問題」。這是實務中常見的誤區——有些企業對所有情況都只使用一種 FMEA 模板。正確的做法是根據風險問題的性質選擇最合適的工具。
blocks.en: TR90 states clearly: "no single risk assessment tool is applicable to all risk questions". This is a common pitfall in practice: some companies use only one FMEA template for every situation. The correct approach is to select the most suitable tool according to the nature of the risk question.

blocks.zh: Table 11.5-1🔍 提供了建立 CCS 基礎風險評估的藍圖。企業在初期建立 CCS 時，應以此表為起點，系統性地對每個污染控制要素進行風險評估。
blocks.en: Table 11.5-1🔍 provides a blueprint for establishing the foundational risk assessments of the CCS. When first building a CCS, a company should use this table as a starting point and systematically carry out a risk assessment for each contamination control element.

blocks.zh: Table 11.5-1🔍 展示了風險評估與 CCS 要素之間的對應關係。值得注意的幾個重點：
blocks.en: Table 11.5-1🔍 shows the correspondence between risk assessments and CCS elements. A few points are worth noting:

blocks.zh: Process FMEA 是最常用的工具，幾乎適用於所有要素
blocks.en: Process FMEA is the most commonly used tool and applies to almost all elements

blocks.zh: Monitoring HACCP 特別適用於環境、物料和公用系統——這些需要持續監控的領域
blocks.en: Monitoring HACCP is particularly suited to environment, materials and utilities, which are areas that require ongoing monitoring

blocks.zh: 對於「新穎或高風險」項目（如新型一次性耗材、新設備），需要額外的專項 FMEA
blocks.en: For "novel or high-risk" items (such as new single-use consumables or new equipment), an additional dedicated FMEA is needed

blocks.zh: 交叉污染 (Cross-contamination) 在多產品設施中需要獨立的 FMEA 評估
blocks.en: Cross-contamination requires a separate FMEA in multi-product facilities

blocks.zh: 對於 CDMO 而言，QRM 的複雜度更高，因為同一設施可能生產多種不同客戶的產品。建議的做法：
blocks.en: For a CDMO, QRM is more complex because the same facility may manufacture products for many different clients. The recommended approach:

blocks.zh: 建立一份「CCS 風險評估清單」(CCS Risk Assessment Registry)，記錄所有已完成和待完成的風險評估
blocks.en: Establish a "CCS Risk Assessment Registry" that records all completed and pending risk assessments

blocks.zh: 依據 Table 11.5-1🔍 的框架，對每個污染控制要素逐一完成基礎風險評估
blocks.en: Following the framework in Table 11.5-1🔍, complete a foundational risk assessment for each contamination control element one by one

blocks.zh: 為每份風險評估設定重新評估的時間週期（例如每 2-3 年或重大變更時）
blocks.en: Set a reassessment interval for each risk assessment (for example every 2-3 years or upon a major change)

blocks.zh: 將風險評估的執行狀態納入預測性 KPI 進行追蹤
blocks.en: Include the execution status of risk assessments in the predictive KPIs for tracking

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR90 說「QRM 不是單一文件」？在實務中，這些多份風險評估如何整合為一個連貫的 QRM 體系？
blocks.en: Why does TR90 say "QRM is not a single document"? In practice, how are these multiple risk assessments integrated into one coherent QRM system?

blocks.zh: Design FMEA 和 HACCP 的核心差異是什麼？為什麼某些場景需要 FMEA 而另一些需要 HACCP？
blocks.en: What is the core difference between Design FMEA and HACCP? Why do some scenarios call for FMEA and others for HACCP?

blocks.zh: 在多產品 CDMO 設施中，交叉污染 FMEA 應該考慮哪些特殊因素？
blocks.en: In a multi-product CDMO facility, what special factors should a cross-contamination FMEA consider?

blocks.zh: 11.6 Quality Agreements and Vendor Management 品質協議與供應商管理
blocks.en: 11.6 Quality Agreements and Vendor Management

blocks.zh: Quality Agreements (品質協議)：這是製藥企業與供應商之間的正式協議，明確雙方在品質管理上的責任與義務。在 CCS 框架下，品質協議應特別涵蓋與污染控制相關的條款。
blocks.en: Quality Agreements: A formal agreement between a pharmaceutical company and a supplier that defines each party's responsibilities and obligations for quality management. Within the CCS framework, quality agreements should specifically include clauses related to contamination control.

blocks.zh: Vendor Qualification (供應商資格認定)：在選擇供應商時，應評估其 CCS 實踐。這不僅是看供應商的 GMP 證書，更要了解其在污染控制方面的具體做法和能力。
blocks.en: Vendor Qualification: When selecting suppliers, their CCS practices should be evaluated. This goes beyond looking at the supplier's GMP certificate; it means understanding the supplier's specific practices and capabilities in contamination control.

blocks.zh: Commensurate with Criticality (與關鍵性相稱)：稽核頻率應與供應材料或服務的關鍵程度成正比。提供直接接觸產品的物料的供應商，稽核頻率應高於提供非關鍵性服務的供應商。
blocks.en: Commensurate with Criticality: Audit frequency should be proportional to the criticality of the material or service supplied. A supplier of materials that come into direct contact with the product should be audited more frequently than a supplier of non-critical services.

blocks.zh: 供應商管理就像餐廳對食材供應商的管控。一間高檔餐廳不會隨便向菜市場買食材就算了——它會與可靠的供應商簽訂品質合約（品質協議），定期到供應商的農場或倉庫查看（稽核），確認食材的來源和品質控制方式。而且，海鮮供應商（高關鍵性）的稽核頻率會比調味料供應商（低關鍵性）更高，因為海鮮的品質風險更大。
blocks.en: Vendor management is like a restaurant's control over its ingredient suppliers. A high-end restaurant does not simply buy ingredients at the market; it signs quality contracts with reliable suppliers (quality agreements), visits the supplier's farm or warehouse regularly (audits), and confirms the source of the ingredients and how quality is controlled. Seafood suppliers (high criticality) are audited more often than seasoning suppliers (low criticality), because the quality risk of seafood is greater.

blocks.zh: TR90 特別提到供應商的「CCS practices」應被評估。這意味著不僅僅是看供應商是否有 GMP 認證，更要深入了解其污染控制的具體做法。例如：供應商的原料/組件是否有適當的微生物控制？其生產環境是否有環境監測程序？是否有變更管制和偏差處理程序？
blocks.en: TR90 specifically mentions that the supplier's "CCS practices" should be evaluated. This means not just checking whether the supplier holds GMP certification, but understanding in depth how it controls contamination. For example: do the supplier's raw materials/components have appropriate microbial controls? Does its production environment have an environmental monitoring program? Does it have change control and deviation handling procedures?

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這一點尤為重要：CDMO 的客戶（委託方）也是 CDMO 的「供應商」之一——客戶提供的原料藥 (DS)、配方資訊和製程參數都會影響 CDMO 的 CCS。因此，與客戶之間的品質協議也需要涵蓋污染控制的相關條款。
blocks.en: This is especially important for a CDMO: the CDMO's clients (sponsors) are also one of its "suppliers", because the drug substance (DS), formulation information and process parameters that the client provides all affect the CDMO's CCS. Therefore, the quality agreement with the client also needs to cover contamination control clauses.

blocks.zh: 品質協議中應包含哪些與 CCS 直接相關的條款？請至少列出五項。
blocks.en: What clauses directly related to the CCS should a quality agreement include? List at least five.

blocks.zh: 如何決定供應商稽核的頻率？「與關鍵性相稱」在實務中如何操作化？
blocks.en: How should the frequency of supplier audits be determined? How is "commensurate with criticality" operationalized in practice?

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 模式下，客戶與 CDMO 之間的品質協議中，哪些污染控制條款最容易被忽略？
blocks.en: In the CDMO model, which contamination control clauses in the quality agreement between client and CDMO are most easily overlooked?

blocks.zh: 11.7 Quality Controls 品質管制
blocks.en: 11.7 Quality Controls

blocks.zh: Quality Control Laboratories (品質管制實驗室)：所有產生 CCS 相關監測數據的實驗室（如微生物實驗室、理化實驗室）都必須在 GMP 管控下運作。這確保了數據的可靠性和完整性。
blocks.en: Quality Control Laboratories: All laboratories that generate CCS-related monitoring data (such as microbiology and physicochemical laboratories) must operate under GMP control. This ensures the reliability and integrity of the data.

blocks.zh: Erroneous Results (錯誤結果)：實驗室產生錯誤結果的可能性應被最小化。當錯誤結果出現時，應作為污染偏差的一部分進行徹底調查。這包括實驗室污染（false positive）和方法失敗（false negative）兩種情況。
blocks.en: Erroneous Results: The potential for a laboratory to produce erroneous results should be minimized. When an erroneous result occurs, it should be thoroughly investigated as part of the contamination deviation. This covers both laboratory contamination (false positive) and method failure (false negative).

blocks.zh: 品質管制實驗室就像法庭上的鑑識實驗室。如果鑑識實驗室本身的操作不規範（未遵循 GMP），那麼它產生的證據（監測數據）就不具公信力。即使偵探（製程工程師）和檢察官（品質保證部門）做了很好的工作，一份不可靠的鑑識報告就足以讓整個案件（CCS）失去可信度。
blocks.en: A quality control laboratory is like a forensic laboratory in a court case. If the forensic laboratory itself does not operate properly (does not follow GMP), the evidence it produces (monitoring data) has no credibility. Even if the detective (process engineer) and the prosecutor (quality assurance) have done excellent work, one unreliable forensic report is enough to destroy the credibility of the whole case (the CCS).

blocks.zh: 這是一段很短但極為重要的條文。TR90 再次引用了 PDA TR88 作為微生物數據偏差調查的參考指引。在實務中，QC 實驗室的 GMP 合規性直接影響 CCS 所有監測數據的可信度。如果 QC 實驗室的環境監測、無菌測試或內毒素檢測結果不可靠，那麼整個 CCS 的決策基礎就會動搖。
blocks.en: This is a very short but extremely important provision. TR90 again cites PDA TR88 as reference guidance for investigating microbial data deviations. In practice, the GMP compliance of the QC laboratory directly affects the credibility of all CCS monitoring data. If the QC laboratory's environmental monitoring, sterility test or endotoxin test results are unreliable, the basis for every CCS decision is shaken.

blocks.zh: 關鍵點：實驗室的「GMP 治理」不只是有 SOP 就好，還包括：人員培訓與資格認定、設備校驗與維護、培養基品質管理、環境條件控制、數據完整性確保等。
blocks.en: Key point: "GMP governance" of the laboratory does not stop at having SOPs. It also includes personnel training and qualification, equipment calibration and maintenance, culture media quality management, control of environmental conditions, and assurance of data integrity.

blocks.zh: 建議 CDMO 的微生物實驗室建立以下關鍵管控：
blocks.en: We recommend that a CDMO's microbiology laboratory establish the following key controls:

blocks.zh: 定期進行實驗室內部環境監測，確保實驗室本身不是污染來源
blocks.en: Perform regular environmental monitoring of the laboratory itself to ensure that the laboratory is not a source of contamination

blocks.zh: 建立「錯誤結果調查」的標準化流程，涵蓋 false positive 和 false negative 兩種情境
blocks.en: Establish a standardized "erroneous result investigation" process that covers both false positive and false negative scenarios

blocks.zh: 將實驗室偏差率納入 CCS 反應性指標進行追蹤
blocks.en: Include the laboratory deviation rate in the CCS reactive metrics for tracking

blocks.zh: 確保實驗室人員了解其產生的數據如何影響整體 CCS 決策
blocks.en: Ensure that laboratory personnel understand how the data they generate affect overall CCS decisions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 QC 實驗室產生的錯誤結果會被視為 CCS 偏差的一部分？這與一般的實驗室偏差處理有何不同？
blocks.en: Why are erroneous results from the QC laboratory treated as part of a CCS deviation? How does this differ from ordinary laboratory deviation handling?

blocks.zh: False positive 和 false negative 分別對 CCS 決策有什麼影響？哪個風險更大？為什麼？
blocks.en: What effects do false positives and false negatives each have on CCS decisions? Which risk is greater, and why?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 品質系統是 CCS 的管理引擎：品質系統提供框架，驅動 CCS 所有面向的正常運作，包括趨勢分析、調查、CAPA、變更管制、QRM、品質協議和品質管制。ICH Q10 提供進一步的實施指引。
blocks.en: The quality system is the management engine of the CCS: The quality system provides the framework that drives the proper operation of all aspects of the CCS, including trending, investigation, CAPA, change control, QRM, quality agreements and quality controls. ICH Q10 provides further implementation guidance.

blocks.zh: 預測性與反應性指標並重：CCS 指標應同時包含前瞻性指標（如品質文化 KPI、CAPA 按時完成率）和事後性指標（如偏差數、環境監測趨勢），以實現整體性的績效監控。
blocks.en: Predictive and reactive metrics are equally important: CCS metrics should include both forward-looking indicators (such as quality culture KPIs and on-time CAPA completion rate) and after-the-fact indicators (such as number of deviations and environmental monitoring trends) to achieve holistic performance monitoring.

blocks.zh: 調查應全面且不預設結論：CCS 相關調查應以整體性方式進行，不預設調查結果，並利用微生物風險評估來識別系統弱點。PDA TR88 提供了詳細的調查方法論。
blocks.en: Investigations should be comprehensive and free of predetermined conclusions: CCS-related investigations should be conducted in a holistic fashion, without a predetermined investigational outcome, and should use microbial risk assessment to identify system weaknesses. PDA TR88 provides detailed investigation methodology.

blocks.zh: CAPA 需考量整體 CCS 影響：有效的 CAPA 不僅解決眼前問題，更強化整個 CCS，其新知識應回饋到 CCS 的定期生命週期審查中。
blocks.en: CAPA must consider the impact on the whole CCS: An effective CAPA not only solves the immediate problem but also strengthens the whole CCS, and its new knowledge should be fed back into the CCS periodic lifecycle review.

blocks.zh: 變更固有帶來污染風險：任何對產品、製程或設施的變更都需要由多方 SME 進行臨時風險審查，評估對 CCS 的影響。
blocks.en: Change inherently carries contamination risk: Any change to a product, process or facility requires an ad-hoc risk review by multiple SMEs to assess the impact on the CCS.

blocks.zh: QRM 是多份風險評估的總和：CCS 的 QRM 由多份聚焦的風險評估組成，使用不同的風險工具（FMEA、HACCP 等）針對不同面向，且為需要定期更新的活文件。
blocks.en: QRM is the sum of multiple risk assessments: QRM for the CCS consists of multiple focused risk assessments that use different risk tools (FMEA, HACCP and others) for different aspects, and they are living documents that must be updated periodically.

blocks.zh: 供應商的 CCS 實踐需被評估：品質協議應涵蓋污染控制相關條款，供應商稽核頻率應與所供應材料或服務的關鍵性相稱。
blocks.en: Suppliers' CCS practices must be evaluated: Quality agreements should cover contamination control clauses, and supplier audit frequency should be commensurate with the criticality of the materials or services supplied.

blocks.zh: QC 實驗室必須受 GMP 治理：所有產生 CCS 監測數據的實驗室都必須在 GMP 管控下運作，錯誤結果的風險應被最小化並徹底調查。
blocks.en: QC laboratories must be under GMP governance: All laboratories that generate CCS monitoring data must operate under GMP control, and the risk of erroneous results should be minimized and thoroughly investigated.
